reviewed_by: Codex focused review of Butler and analyst image attachments
reason: The two selected component files contain 38 collected cases and cover visible image discovery, supported and unsupported runtimes, upload and send failure recovery, cross-project isolation, preview, and the image content block passed to Butler. The image catalog entry contains 16 collected mock browser capability cases across desktop Chromium and emulated mobile Chromium and WebKit, two collected side-chat toolbar cases, and two disposable real-Core LAN cases that verify model delivery and durable reload for Butler and analyst chat. The production UI build is checked separately. Three collected Python cases verify the existing harness artifact boundary and Codex app-server image request serialization used by an image-capable Butler.
exclusions: No Python or native source changed; only the two existing harness image boundaries are selected. Unrelated chat, provider, Voice, storage, and full suites are excluded. Real-Core cases use disposable local Core and model stub instances, a production bundle, and a non-loopback LAN origin. Physical Mac and iPhone browser checks are unavailable in this environment.
